nom: SKINN Dermappeal® Daily Moisturizing Face Scrub - Gentle Exfoliator

avis.texte: I am a big fan of ZO Skin Health products and they have a microdermabrasion product that I love. I was on the search for a dupe due to the price of the ZO product and found a few websites listing this due to its similar ingredients so I gave it a try. I found the texture of this product far more coarse than that of the ZO product and there is a very strong scent which I found a bit irritating to my skin. I don't have the most sensitive skin but with the coarse abrasion and strong scents, I found my skin feeling a little sensitive during use. After use however, my skin did feel quite smooth and clarified but I felt other products more than usual. As it is only 1oz, I did notice that I was running quite low after only a few weeks, while use maybe 2 times per week.

I was influenced thought I would try the Skinn derma and I absolutely love it. I use about a quarter size amount on my wet face. I use circular motion for my face. I also use the little face brush to help remove the dead skin. I let it sit for 2-5 mins then rise off. My skin feels amazing. My skincare is better absorbed. My skin is brighter since I started a couple of weeks ago. I use it 3 times a week. I have sensitive skin and it doesn’t bother it.

avis.titre: Unleash Your Inner Glow: SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal Review
avis.texte: SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal is a total game-changer in my skincare routine! Imagine having the power of a professional microdermabrasion treatment right at your fingertips, in the comfort of your own home. That's exactly what Dermappeal delivers. It's like magic in a bottle—it smooths away wrinkles, banishes dry and dead skin cells, and even fades those pesky dark spots. But here's the best part: it's not just effective, it's also a luxurious experience. The scent is absolutely divine, like a refreshing trip to the spa every time I use it. And let me tell you, the results are beyond impressive. My skin has never looked or felt better since I started using Dermappeal. Sure, it's an investment, but trust me when I say it's worth every single penny. The confidence boost alone is priceless. If you're tired of dull, lackluster skin and ready to unleash your inner glow, SKINN Skin Care Dermappeal is the answer you've been searching for. Trust me, you'll wonder how you ever lived without it.

I love this product! After two weeks of using, it I started to get compliments on my makeup. My skin looks and feels smoother and softer, and my makeup goes on so much better. Thats saying something because I'm 68.
It clenses without drying out my skin. However, it doesn't really exfoliating or brighten my skin at all.

I bought the Skinn Dermappeal Daily because I have very sensitive skin. I love the regular Dermappeal but can only use once a week. I love the Dermappeal Daily, it is easy on my skin and keeps those pores cleaned out! I have been using Skin products 2002, when Dimitri started introducing his products.

I love this formula, it's gritty enough where I feel it's doing something, but it's not so gritty that it leaves traces in the bottom of the shower like sand. My skin feels very smooth after using. Unfortunately it's a little too pricey for me so I will not use this very often. But it is one of the best products I found as far as a facial scrub.

avis.titre: This made a positive impact on my facial complexion after just one use.
avis.texte: This facial exfoliation by SKINN worked amazingly well on my first use. To begin, after a few hours, I noticed that the skin on my nose, which tends to show pores, looked smooth, tight and healthier. My facial complexion also looked healthier, and clean, and radiant. This surprised me, since my complexion actually improved during the day. This exfoliation is meant to be applied prior to using a facial cleanser. I used a dime sized portion, and scrubbed my face, forehead and neck. One interesting note; After getting out of the shower, I looked at my facial complexion, and noticed some reddish patches where I had more vigorously scrubbed this exfoliator. They remained for 30 mins after I applied a facial moisturizer. A few hours later, there was no sign of redness. So key here is to not scrub to hard. Be gentle when applying this product. I have tried so many different facial scrubs, and nothing compares to this product in terms of instant impact. It’s really noticeable. I can’t wait to see what happens on my second use! Thank you for reading this honest review.

avis.titre: Brightens, Smooths, Reduces Pore Size for my Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I use the regular Dermappeal by Skinn one to two times a week, and love it for exfoliating my sensitive skin, and wanted to try this product to use daily. I don't like trying products that don't have a full ingredient list displayed in their description, however, I was able to find it on Skinn's website and posted a photo of it. I react to almost everything, but this product made my skin so soft and smooth, and reduced the appearance of my enlarged pores. I have combination skin with really oily skin on my forehead and nose, and this product remarkably helped reduce the oil in those areas. It doesn't have a strong scent which I really appreciate. I think that it makes a difference for me and makes my skin look better. I still like the original Dermappeal better, but this is great for using on the days I don't use Dermappeal.

I love this face scrub. It is creamy and moisturizing but yet it had very gentle exfoliating texture. I can use this every day without bothering my skin and sometimes my skin can be sensitive because of my rosacea. I also like the smell it has a very mild clean smell. I like the feel of my skin after waking with this it is smooth and moisturized. The price is a little more than I like to spend but I would probably get it again because I really enjoy it.

I love Dimitri and Skinn products but was a bit shocked at the size of this product for the price. Its smaller than my index finger. I have had great success with other Skinn products and am sure i will with this as well but I will need to see if it comes in a larger size or i will need to repurchase frequently which would be annoying
Photos in the post showed a different size! Look how tiny! Not worth $20!

You only need to use a small amount of the exfoliator and you don’t need to scrub too hard. My skin felt refreshed and smooth after the first use. My skin typically feels dried out after using most scrubs, but this was not the case with SKINN. I have been using this for about a week with no issues. I also like that it does not have a strong scent and since only a small amount is needed, it will last for awhile :)
Great product!! Very exfoliating to the skin!! Very easy to use and gentle on my skin!! Leaving it soft and refreshing!! Love it

small beads exfoliating facial scrub; my sensitive skin didn't result to redness or irritation from using it the first time; makes my skin smooth and feel fresh after each use; small amount is sufficient to wash the face
